title: Schedule change notice
description: Notify ticket holders about a change of time or venue. Account alert WhatsApp template for events. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Say clearly what changed and what, if anything, attendees must do. Time-sensitive alerts suit utility.

body.text: Important update for *{{event_name}}*, {{first_name}}: the start time has changed to {{time}} on {{date}}. Your tickets remain valid.
